repos_data.description: Universal BLE Smart Scale bridge. Captures body composition from Renpho, Xiaomi & 20+ others, syncs to Garmin Connect, Strava, MQTT (Home Assistant), InfluxDB, Webhooks, Ntfy & local files (CSV/JSONL). Headless CLI for Raspberry Pi, Linux, macOS & Windows.

Open CC-BY-4.0 dataset of evidence-graded dietary-supplement data: dosing, bioavailability, drug-nutrient interactions, cost-per-effective-dose. Every claim carries a PubMed PMID. DOI 10.57967/hf/9356
Open-source Apple Health MCP server for the MetricBridge iOS app: query 190 HealthKit metrics from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes and any AI agent. Zero-dependency, local-first, read-only.
Local-first continuous glucose monitor MCP — Dexcom Developer API, FreeStyle Libre via LibreLink Up. Levels-killer, agent-first.
